preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(adj, list) and len(adj) == N and all(isinstance(row, list) and len(row) == N and all(c in (0, 1) for c in row) for row in adj)
preconditions.description: The adjacency matrix is an N x N list of lists containing only 0s and 1s.
M is an integer between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(k, int) and 0 <= k <= 10**9 and isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= N for k, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of a non-negative integer k up to 10^9 and a gnome id x between 1 and N.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly two lines for each of the M queries.

postconditions.expression: all((int(output_lines[2*i]) == len(reachable_set(i, k, x, adj, N)) and (output_lines[2*i+1] == '-1' if len(reachable_set(i, k, x, adj, N)) == 0 else ' '.join(map(str, sorted(reachable_set(i, k, x, adj, N))))) for i, (k, x) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query i with parameters k and x, the first output line is the count of gnomes reachable in exactly k steps, and the second line is either -1 (if count is 0) or the sorted space-separated IDs of those gnomes.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= g <= N for g in (sorted(reachable_set(i, k, x, adj, N)) if len(reachable_set(i, k, x, adj, N)) > 0 else [])) for i, (k, x) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: All gnome IDs listed in the output are valid integers between 1 and N.
